mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden 1-month decline in the unemployment rate below 4.5% signals strengthening labor market conditions, prompting investor optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4.5% in a month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE falls below 4.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in the federal funds rate and rise in quarterly billings (GDPC1) signal accommodative monetary policy and robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction of FEDFUNDS decline and GDPC1 rise does not lead to significantly higher 60-day returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a monthly decline in the CPIAUCSL below 2.0% signals weakening inflationary pressures, prompting expectations of rate cuts and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL falls below 2.0% in a month during late-cycle expansion
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, CPIAUCSL falling below 2.0% does not result in positive 20-day returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly surge in HOUST above 1050 units indicates heightened demand for goods and services, driving investor confidence and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises above 1050 units in a month
failure_condition: HOUST rising above 1050 units in a month does not correlate with positive 5-day returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in RSAFS (demand) and quarterly billings (GDPC1) signals robust economic activity and strong equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The combined effect of RSAFS and GDPC1 rising does not produce significantly higher 60-day returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in quarterly billings (GDPC1) over three months indicates growing economic demand, which compresses discount rates and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 rising over three months does not lead to positive 20-day returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-demand expansion, a monthly surge in HOUST above 1050 units signals peak demand momentum, prompting investors to anticipate sustained growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises above 1050 units in a month during late-demand expansion
failure_condition: In late-demand expansion, HOUST rising above 1050 units does not result in positive 60-day returns (p > 0.05).
